title: School routine
prompt: I ___ to school every day.
text: I go to school every day.
translation: Men har kuni maktabga boraman.

title: My family
prompt: My sister ___ a blue bicycle.
text: My sister has a blue bicycle.
translation: Mening singlimning ko‘k velosipedi bor.

title: In the classroom
prompt: There ___ a computer on the desk.
text: There is a computer on the desk.
translation: Stol ustida kompyuter bor.

title: After school
prompt: We ___ playing football after school.
text: We like playing football after school.
translation: Biz maktabdan keyin futbol o‘ynashni yoqtiramiz.

title: A useful habit
prompt: I ___ type short sentences carefully and clearly.
text: I can type short sentences carefully and clearly.
translation: Men qisqa gaplarni ehtiyotkorlik va ravshanlik bilan tera olaman.

title: Yesterday
prompt: Yesterday, I ___ my homework before dinner.
text: Yesterday, I finished my homework before dinner.
translation: Kecha men kechki ovqatdan oldin uy vazifamni tugatdim.

title: Weekend plan
prompt: We are going to ___ the science museum on Saturday.
text: We are going to visit the science museum on Saturday.
translation: Biz shanba kuni fan muzeyiga tashrif buyurmoqchimiz.

title: Healthy routine
prompt: She ___ drinks water before her morning lesson.
text: She usually drinks water before her morning lesson.
translation: U odatda ertalabki darsidan oldin suv ichadi.

title: Comparing devices
prompt: This laptop is ___ than the old computer.
text: This laptop is faster than the old computer.
translation: Bu noutbuk eski kompyuterdan tezroq.

title: Learning together
prompt: I enjoy group projects ___ we can share ideas.
text: I enjoy group projects because we can share ideas.
translation: Men guruh loyihalarini yoqtiraman, chunki biz fikr almasha olamiz.

title: A better result
prompt: If I practise regularly, I ___ more accurately.
text: If I practise regularly, I will type more accurately.
translation: Agar muntazam mashq qilsam, aniqroq teraman.

title: The helpful teacher
prompt: The teacher ___ helped us explained the task clearly.
text: The teacher who helped us explained the task clearly.
translation: Bizga yordam bergan o‘qituvchi vazifani aniq tushuntirdi.

title: A finished project
prompt: Our team has already ___ the first version of the app.
text: Our team has already completed the first version of the app.
translation: Jamoamiz ilovaning birinchi versiyasini allaqachon tugatgan.

title: Safe research
prompt: Students ___ check the source before sharing information.
text: Students should check the source before sharing information.
translation: O‘quvchilar ma’lumotni ulashishdan oldin manbani tekshirishlari kerak.

title: Solving a problem
prompt: Although the program failed at first, we found the error and ___ it.
text: Although the program failed at first, we found the error and fixed it.
translation: Dastur avval ishlamagan bo‘lsa-da, biz xatoni topib tuzatdik.

title: Effective learning
prompt: Regular feedback enables learners to ___ their weaknesses.
text: Regular feedback enables learners to identify their weaknesses.
translation: Muntazam fikr-mulohaza o‘quvchilarga zaif tomonlarini aniqlash imkonini beradi.

title: Responsible technology
prompt: Personal data must be ___ by strong security rules.
text: Personal data must be protected by strong security rules.
translation: Shaxsiy ma’lumotlar kuchli xavfsizlik qoidalari bilan himoyalanishi kerak.

title: Innovation
prompt: While automation saves time, it also ___ careful human supervision.
text: While automation saves time, it also requires careful human supervision.
translation: Avtomatlashtirish vaqtni tejasa-da, u insonning sinchkov nazoratini ham talab qiladi.

title: Evaluating information
prompt: Before accepting a claim, readers should examine whether the evidence is ___.
text: Before accepting a claim, readers should examine whether the evidence is reliable.
translation: Da’voni qabul qilishdan oldin o‘quvchilar dalil ishonchli ekanini tekshirishlari kerak.

title: Collaborative improvement
prompt: Had the team tested each component earlier, they would have ___ the problem sooner.
text: Had the team tested each component earlier, they would have discovered the problem sooner.
translation: Jamoa har bir qismni oldinroq sinaganida, muammoni tezroq aniqlagan bo‘lardi.
